name: EngineAI
summary:
EngineAI develops humanoid robots and related embodied-intelligence products, covering design, manufacturing and application deployment. Founded in October 2023 and headquartered in Shenzhen, it develops core components, robot bodies, motion-control algorithms and intelligent behavior as a connected technology stack.

Its platforms include PM01 and other humanoid products intended for research, education, industrial work and commercial services. Public demonstrations combine learning-based whole-body movement with interactive service and entertainment applications. The company also pursues partnerships to adapt its technology to practical operating environments, with a broader aim of extending robotics into household companionship and everyday assistance.
